detections.description: Sustained violent group clash between a crowd (including yellow-vested individuals) and riot police in full gear, involving shield formations, pushing, spraying (visible at f6), and dense confrontation across the street.

A woman in a pink beanie and black jacket is engaged in close physical struggle with multiple riot police officers; she pushes, grabs, and is restrained by officers using shields and hands in a chaotic melee.

The woman in the pink beanie appears overwhelmed and pinned against officers while being struck or forcefully pushed; her posture suggests helplessness amid coordinated restraint by multiple officers.

Police in full riot gear (helmets, shields, body armor) form a tight line confronting a civilian (wearing a patterned beanie and backpack) at close range; the posture and equipment indicate an active, tense standoff typical of a riot situation.; Large crowd of protesters, many wearing yellow vests, densely packed in a street with visible smoke/gas in the background; individuals are actively gesturing, filming, and moving dynamically amid police presence—indicating ongoing collective violent unrest or violent group clashes.

A tense confrontation between a group of individuals (including at least one yellow-vested person) and multiple police officers in riot gear, involving close physical proximity, shields raised, and apparent attempts to control or disperse the crowd—indicative of collective violent unrest or violent group clash.

A person wearing a pink beanie and purple backpack is surrounded and physically restrained by multiple police officers in riot gear; one officer appears to push or shove the individual while others close in, suggesting an unprovoked or disproportionate use of force against a non-resisting individual.

A police officer bends down near a detained individual standing beside a police van, appearing to secure or search them while they are in a vulnerable position; the context suggests coercive handling without visible resistance from the individual.

A large group of individuals wearing yellow vests is gathered in a city street intersection, with visible debris and yellow paint splatters on the wet road surface; some individuals appear to be moving dynamically, and the overall scene suggests collective unrest or confrontation, consistent with a riotous situation.
